description: Update repos/goal-host-vessel/src/registry-field.ts to treat the wording "count of" as a counting trigger, joining the existing alternation of "how many", "number of" and "total", so that a question such as "the count of vessels" is no longer rejected as naming an entity the registry does not track.
goal_text: Update repos/goal-host-vessel/src/registry-field.ts to treat the wording "count of" as a counting trigger, joining the existing alternation of "how many", "number of" and "total", so that a question such as "the count of vessels" is no longer rejected as naming an entity the registry does not track.
